semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Teesing Industrial Systems provides components and assemblies for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in ultra-high purity environments.
summary: Teesing Industrial Systems specializes in supplying high-purity (HP/UHP) components and assemblies for semiconductor applications, including fittings, hoses, valves, and regulators. They operate cleanroom facilities capable of producing components for both prototypes and volume production, ensuring minimal contamination levels.
capabilities: Assembly of UHP fittings and components in class 100 cleanroom
Testing cleanliness using UV and Laser techniques
Handling of extreme clean dry air (XCDA) with sub ppb contaminant levels

regional_presence.China: Teesing has a presence in Beijing, focusing on the semiconductor and related industries.
